notes.title: We're making a new game called Cozy Beach!
notes.content:
Very cool news everyone, we are working on a new PC game called [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3489070/Cozy_Beach/?utm_source=CindySteamUpdate]Cozy Beach[/url]!  It's a game where you can water tube, fish and chill with your friends in a tropical paradise.

There's lot of fun stuff to do there!
🏝 Explore a tropical island solo, co-op or online
😸 Customize an adorable animal avatar and dress them up with lots of stylish options.
🎣 Go fishing and try to collect every fish - some might take a couple players to catch!
🔎 Discover treasure maps and hunt for treasure- what kind of cool stuff will you find?
🍍 Collect fruits, and craft fun and silly tropical drinks from the friendly capybara barkeep - the rarer the ingredients, the more exotic the drink!
⭕  Go water tubing in a lazy river around the beautiful tropical island to take in the sights.
🎶 Jam out to sweet tunes on the radio!
And of course, no day at the beach is complete without hanging out and chatting with your friends 👯‍♂️ 

If this sounds like fun, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3489070/Cozy_Beach/?utm_source=CindySteamUpdate]go give it a wishlist today[/url] to join us on the peaceful shores of Cozy Beach! 😸 💖

notes.title: Cinderella VR is taking part in the Steam Summer sale!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

In celebration of the Steam Summer Sale, we've discounted Cinderella VR to 50% for a limited time only!!

This is our first VR title and it's filled with fun virtual reality stuff- fully voiced and animated characters, and tons of super interactive minigames!  Jump, dodge and dance in this active and fun VR title!

Have fun and good luck!
(And don't forget to make it home by midnight or you'll turn into a pumpkin!)

[i]LunaBeat[/i]

notes.title: Achievements Added & More!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
We're here to announce a brand-new update for Cinderella VR!

First of all- we added ACHIEVEMENTS!!  Now you can mark your progress to show off your Cinderella VR skills to the world.  There's even some new challenges!  Try to get through the carriage ride without a single hit- can you steer the pumpkin carriage to success to become a Chariot Champion?!  Can you be a master Party Popper and pop 10 balloons in the ending sequence??  Try it and find out!

We also have some updates based on reviews & player feedback!  We've heard that the audio is not quite leveled properly, so we went back over the game audio and worked hard to get the audio levels more balanced.

Height was another issue- we found out that some areas of the game are inaccessible for shorter players.  We've added compensation for this by adjusting a few of the minigames to scale to the user's height.  Now anyone can complete the game!

Also- you may have noticed we added Cinderella VR to our LunaBeat Collection bundle!  Check it out, you can purchase our other VR game "Paranormal Detective: Escape from the 80's" for a discount if you already own Cinderella VR!

Thanks so much everyone for supporting the game, it means the world to us!!  Stay safe & healthy!

notes.title: Dancing Game Rework & More Exciting Changes!
notes.content:
Thank you everyone for your amazing support for Cinderella VR!
We've been thrilled to see some great reviews and some awesome Let's Play videos- it's been so cool seeing everyone enjoy the game!!

Our update comes with some big changes!  We altered the dancing mini game so it's easier and more fun to play- we think you'll love it!  Players can hold their controllers on the spheres, which make the incoming music notes easier to hit.

We also adjusted audio levels throughout the game for a more enjoyable and immersive virtual experience.

Lastly, we fixed a bug with player height detection- so if certain minigames were too low to play before, they are at the correct height now!

We hope you've been loving the game so far- thanks so much for playing Cinderella VR!
